title: Wither Head Cannon
description: Adds a wither head projectile launcher into the game, inspired by the Unstable SMP exploited weapons, deals tons of damage to players around.
body:
# Wither Head Cannon

Wither Head Cannon is a mod & a plugin, inspired by the Unstable SMP. Allows you to call down countless Wither Head Projectiles (a vanilla projectile) to any location that you're looking at.

## Usage

**Usage contains commands such as: **

- /withercannon single - Gives a rod, breaks after one pull of the rod,

- /withercannon inf - Gives a rod, doesn't break at all,

- /withercannon2 single - Gives a nether star, breaks after one use, right click to use,

- /withercannon2 inf - Gives a nether star, doesn't break at all, right click to use.

**_FYI: It's not been made clear on what the wither cannon uses, that's why I have added 2 items :] When the protagonists will show us what is used to control it, I will update it. And if it's a redstone contraption that doesn't use an item, I'll keep it the same way!_**

## Inspiration

- Inspired by the Unstable SMP series, a scripted SMP with four main protagonists. More deeply, inspired by @SpokeIsHere video titled ,,Unstable SMP: Purgatory'' | [Spoke's Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8_Au10osdEo&t=7037s)

## Bug Reports:

- Bug reports can be submitted with the use of Discord, you can add me via my tag: houstonp901 - I accept direct messages & friend requests.
